sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，在一处加利福尼亚州的葡萄园里发现了一具女尸。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她遭到了斩首，体内的血液也被抽干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 看来凶手费尽了心思来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，人们只知道她叫无名氏。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于知道了她的名字叫阿达。

sentences.en: But, identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但是，确认她的身份反而让这起离奇的谋杀案更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now, wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《阿达》是 Casefile Presents 推出的全新系列，现已上线，您可以在各大播客平台收听。

sentences.en: Brembate di Sopra is a small and picturesque town 7km, or 4 miles, northwest of the city of Bergamo, in northern Italy, about an hour's drive from Milan.
sentences.zh: 布伦巴泰迪索普拉是一座风景如画的小镇，位于意大利北部贝加莫市西北方 7 公里（约 4 英里）处，距离米兰约一小时车程。

sentences.en: The province of Lombardi covers the cities of Milan and Bergamo, including the small town of Brembate di Sopra.
sentences.zh: 伦巴第大区涵盖了米兰和贝加莫等城市，其中包括布伦巴泰迪索普拉这个小镇。

sentences.en: With its close proximity to Lake Como and the Swiss and Austrian borders, it is a popular stopover for tourists.
sentences.zh: 由于毗邻科莫湖以及瑞士和奥地利边境，这里是游客热门的中转站。

sentences.en: The area is dotted with ancient villas and palastos.
sentences.zh: 该地区点缀着古老的别墅和宫殿。

sentences.en: It is a humble town, not modernised to the extent of nearby Milan.
sentences.zh: 这是一个质朴的小镇，没有像附近的米兰那样过度现代化。

sentences.en: Many homes still use wood-burning stoves, raise chickens, and grow their own vegetables.
sentences.zh: 许多家庭仍然使用燃木炉，养鸡，并自己种植蔬菜。

sentences.en: Postcards of the snow-capped Bergamo Alps sit in shop displays, and the views from the small town are a reminder that things don't change at a fast pace in rural Italy.
sentences.zh: 印有白雪皑皑的贝加莫阿尔卑斯山风光的明信片陈列在商店的橱窗里，从小镇望出去的景色提醒着人们，意大利乡村的生活节奏并没有那么快。

sentences.en: The town has a traditional historic centre, classic church steeples, and winding paths and gardens.
sentences.zh: 小镇拥有传统的历史中心、经典的教堂尖塔以及蜿蜒的小路和花园。

sentences.en: It still feels like an old town, with old traditions and values.
sentences.zh: 它依然保留着古老小镇的感觉，有着古老的传统和价值观。

sentences.en: Every year the small town hosts a street parade, where townsfolk and others from the area come together to dress in harlequin fancy dress,
sentences.zh: 每年这个小镇都会举办一场街头游行，镇民和周边地区的居民会聚在一起，穿上丑角的化装服，

sentences.en: and make traditional wooden floats to parade the streets.
sentences.zh: 并制作传统的木制花车在街上游行。

sentences.en: Like many old areas of the country, family values are deeply rooted, and people are fiercely loyal.
sentences.zh: 就像这个国家的许多古老地区一样，家庭观念根深蒂固，人们极其忠诚。

sentences.en: With around 8,000 residents, Brembate de Sopra is a quiet, close-knit, rural community.
sentences.zh: 布伦巴泰迪索普拉拥有大约 8,000 名居民，是一个安静、团结的乡村社区。

sentences.en: A safe environment for a young family.
sentences.zh: 这是一个适合年轻家庭的安全环境。

sentences.en: A place where a 13-year-old girl walking to a nearby sports centre, alone in the late afternoon, was not given a second thought.
sentences.zh: 在这里，一个 13 岁的女孩在傍晚独自一人步行去附近的体育中心，甚至不会引起人们的第二次注意。

sentences.en: In November 2010, winter was setting in.
sentences.zh: 2010 年 11 月，冬天即将来临。

sentences.en: The days were cold, averaging around 7 degrees Celsius, or 45 Fahrenheit.
sentences.zh: 天气很冷，平均气温在 7 摄氏度左右，即 45 华氏度。

sentences.en: And the nearby ski resorts were gearing up for the season.
sentences.zh: 附近的滑雪场正在为新雪季做准备。

sentences.en: 13-year-old Yara Gambiraccio was passionate about gymnastics, enjoyed school, and lived with a happy family.
sentences.zh: 13 岁的亚拉·甘比拉西奥对体操充满热情，喜欢学校生活，并生活在一个幸福的家庭中。

sentences.en: She always wore her dark curly hair out, except while doing gymnastic training or competitions, where it would be pulled straight back tightly off her face.
sentences.zh: 她总是散着一头黑色的卷发，只有在进行体操训练或比赛时，才会把头发紧紧地向后梳，露出脸庞。

sentences.en: Her father, Fulvio, an architect, was a solid man with thick glasses.
sentences.zh: 她的父亲富尔维奥是一名建筑师，身材魁梧，戴着厚厚的眼镜。

sentences.en: His wife, and Yara's mother, Mara, was a teacher.
sentences.zh: 他的妻子、亚拉的母亲马拉是一名教师。

sentences.en: They were a grounded family, who were active in the community.
sentences.zh: 他们是一个脚踏实地的家庭，积极参与社区活动。

sentences.en: Their families had been in the area for generations.
sentences.zh: 他们的家族在这个地区已经生活了好几代人。

sentences.en: Fulvio and Mara had four children.
sentences.zh: 富尔维奥和马拉育有四个孩子。

sentences.en: The eldest was daughter Kiba, aged 15.
sentences.zh: 老大是女儿基巴，15 岁。

sentences.en: Yara, who was 13.
sentences.zh: 亚拉，13 岁。

sentences.en: And then two younger sons, Natan and Gioli.
sentences.zh: 还有两个年幼的弟弟，纳坦和焦利。

sentences.en: On Friday, the 26th of November 2010, Yara was gearing up for a gymnastics competition the following weekend.
sentences.zh: 2010 年 11 月 26 日，星期五，亚拉正在为接下来周末的体操比赛做准备。

sentences.en: After spending the afternoon with her family at home, she left about 5.15pm.
sentences.zh: 下午和家人在家共度时光后，她在下午 5 点 15 分左右出门。

sentences.en: She told her mother she was going to the local sports centre where she trained to return a stereo to her gymnastics instructor, Sylvia Brenner.
sentences.zh: 她告诉母亲，她要去她训练的当地体育中心，把一台音响还给她的体操教练西尔维娅·布伦纳。

sentences.en: Yara left the house in black leggings, a Hello Kitty t-shirt, and a black bomber-style jacket, the short type with knitted ribbed bands at the hem and sleeve cuffs.
sentences.zh: 亚拉出门时穿着黑色打底裤、一件凯蒂猫T恤和一件黑色飞行员夹克，就是那种下摆和袖口带有针织罗纹的短款夹克。

sentences.en: The sports centre was only 700 metres from her family home.
sentences.zh: 体育中心距离她家只有 700 米。

sentences.en: Yara was at the sports centre often, and usually got there by walking on her own.
sentences.zh: 亚拉经常去体育中心，通常都是自己步行去那里。

sentences.en: It was a large sports building, much like a school, with a big gate, many entrances, sports courts, a running track, and a swimming pool.
sentences.zh: 这是一个大型体育建筑，很像一所学校，有大门、多个入口、运动场、跑道和游泳池。

sentences.en: Yara briefly greeted her instructor and saw some of her gymnastics friends before she did a little training.
sentences.zh: 亚拉简单地向教练打了个招呼，见了几位体操朋友，然后进行了一会儿训练。

sentences.en: She left the building just prior to 6.44pm.
sentences.zh: 她在下午 6 点 44 分之前离开大楼。

sentences.en: At 6.44pm, Yara sent a text message to her gymnastics friend Martina, confirming they would meet the following Sunday at 8am.
sentences.zh: 下午 6 点 44 分，亚拉给体操朋友玛蒂娜发了一条短信，确认他们将于周日上午 8 点见面。

sentences.en: It was the last contact Yara had with anyone.
sentences.zh: 这是亚拉与任何人的最后一次联系。

sentences.en: Her mother, Mara, didn't expect her to be gone long, and she kept a close watch on the clock.
sentences.zh: 她的母亲马拉并没有指望她离开太久，并不时紧盯着时钟。

sentences.en: By 7pm, she was worried.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上 7 点，她开始担心了。

sentences.en: At 7.11pm, she phoned Yara's phone, but the call went straight to voicemail.
sentences.zh: 晚上 7 点 11 分，她给亚拉的手机打电话，但电话直接转入了语音信箱。

sentences.en: 20 minutes later, Yara's father, Fulvio, called the police.
sentences.zh: 20 分钟后，亚拉的父亲富尔维奥报警了。

sentences.en: The call was put through to the public prosecutor's office in Bergamo, where the prosecutor on duty was Letizia Ruggieri.
sentences.zh: 电话被转到了贝加莫的检察官办公室，当时值班的检察官是莱蒂齐亚·鲁杰里。

sentences.en: Ruggieri was 45 years old, a tough former policewoman who had earned respect within the force working against the Sicilian Mafia in Sicily, southern Italy.
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里现年 45 岁，是一位坚强的前女警官，曾在意大利南部西西里岛打击西西里黑手党的行动中赢得警界尊重。

sentences.en: Ruggieri didn't waste time, and within five minutes of receiving the call, had dispatched both state police officers and the Carabinieri military police to their village.
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里没有浪费时间，在接到电话后五分钟内，就同时派出了国家警察和宪兵部队前往他们的村庄。

sentences.en: The family was fraught.
sentences.zh: 这家人心急如焚。

sentences.en: People came out of their houses to help search for Yara.
sentences.zh: 人们走出家门帮忙寻找亚拉。

sentences.en: The fire department walked the banks of the river.
sentences.zh: 消防部门沿河岸搜寻。

sentences.en: Police and volunteers searched nearby fields, abandoned buildings, and asked passers-by if they had seen Yara.
sentences.zh: 警察和志愿者搜查了附近的田野、废弃建筑，并询问路人是否见过亚拉。

sentences.en: The entire sports centre was searched inside and out.
sentences.zh: 整个体育中心里里外外都搜查了个遍。

sentences.en: Walter Brimbilla, who was the manager of the centre, said that at midnight, the night Yara disappeared, they were still searching the centre in case she was trapped or hiding.
sentences.zh: 担任中心经理的沃尔特·布兰比拉表示，在亚拉失踪当晚的午夜，他们仍在搜查中心，以防她被困或躲藏起来。

sentences.en: As snow started to fall that evening, Yara's gym instructor, Sylvia Brenner, confirmed Yara had made it to the gym, but she hadn't seen her since.
sentences.zh: 那天傍晚开始下雪，亚拉的体操教练西尔维娅·布伦纳证实亚拉确实去了体育馆，但此后就没见过她。

sentences.en: Letizia Ruggieri was the chief investigator on the case.
sentences.zh: 莱蒂齐亚·鲁杰里是该案的主负责调查员。

sentences.en: She called in Tracker Dogs, a breed of Italian bloodhounds, to try to track the path where Yara had gone.
sentences.zh: 她召集了追踪犬——一种意大利猎犬，试图追踪亚拉走过的路线。

sentences.en: The Tracker Dogs didn't follow the path back to Yara's home.
sentences.zh: 追踪犬并没有沿着小路追踪回亚拉的家。

sentences.en: Instead, they trailed off towards Mapello, a small hamlet 3 kilometres or 1.8 miles in the opposite direction.
sentences.zh: 相反，它们朝着相反方向 3 公里或 1.8 英里外的小村庄马佩洛方向追踪过去。

sentences.en: By then, the team had been able to analyse the last signals from Yara's mobile phone.
sentences.zh: 此时，专案组已经能够分析亚拉手机的最后信号。

sentences.en: Her phone had shown a signal in Mapello at 6.49pm the evening of her disappearance,
sentences.zh: 她的手机显示，在她失踪当晚的 6 点 49 分在马佩洛有信号发出，

sentences.en: only five minutes after Yara had sent the text message to her friend Martina as she left the sports centre.
sentences.zh: 就在亚拉离开体育中心时给她朋友玛蒂娜发完短信仅仅五分钟后。

sentences.en: The police realised that it was very likely Yara, or at least her phone, had travelled by car to where it was last pinged in Mapello.
sentences.zh: 警方意识到，亚拉很可能，或者至少她的手机是坐车前往马佩洛信号最后出现的地方的。

sentences.en: Over the next few days, Ruggieri and her team questioned every member of the Gambiracio family, looking for signs of problems, arguments or secrets.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几天里，鲁杰里和她的团队讯问了甘比拉西奥家族的每一位成员，寻找是否存在问题、争吵或秘密的迹象。

sentences.en: Although shy from the enormous media presence that had descended on their quiet street, they seemed like a happy, close family with nothing to hide.
sentences.zh: 尽管面对蜂拥至他们平静街道的庞大媒体阵仗显得有些羞怯，但他们看起来是一个幸福、紧密且无可隐瞒的家庭。

sentences.en: The family shared some photographs of Yara with the media in the days after her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 失踪后的几天里，这家人向媒体分享了一些亚拉的照片。

sentences.en: Yara queuing to take communion, doing gymnastics, a photo of her in an Italian football shirt and a few others.
sentences.zh: 亚拉排队领圣餐的照片、做体操的照片、一张她穿着意大利足球队球衣的照片以及其他几张。

sentences.en: But no one came forward with any useful information.
sentences.zh: 但没有人提供任何有用的信息。

sentences.en: A few people told police they thought they may have seen Yara talking to a couple of people near a red car.
sentences.zh: 有几个人告诉警方，他们觉得自己可能看到亚拉在一辆红车附近和几个人说话。

sentences.en: But it was a false lead.
sentences.zh: 但这只是一条假线索。

sentences.en: With no sign of Yara, investigators concentrated their efforts on tracking down people whose mobile phones had been used near where she disappeared.
sentences.zh: 在没有任何亚拉踪迹的情况下，调查人员将精力集中在追踪那些在她失踪地点附近使用过手机的人身上。

sentences.en: Approximately 15,000 phones were found to have been in the area that day.
sentences.zh: 经查，当天在该地区大约有 15,000 部手机。

sentences.en: Police commenced the enormous task of tracing each phone to its owner.
sentences.zh: 警方展开了艰巨的任务，将每一部手机追查到其所有者。

sentences.en: Hundreds of phones were wiretapped and what would be a record for any investigation in Italy's history.
sentences.zh: 数百部手机被监听，这在意大利调查史上创下了纪录。

sentences.en: Tens of millions of phone calls were intercepted.
sentences.zh: 数千万通电话被拦截。

sentences.en: Crime news dominates Italian TV, often playing out on television like a soap opera.
sentences.zh: 犯罪新闻充斥着意大利电视，经常在电视上像肥皂剧一样上演。

sentences.en: Reports can be dramatised and people involved hounded for their story.
sentences.zh: 报道可能会被戏剧化，涉案人员也会被追着索要故事。

sentences.en: Not since the murder of Meredith Kircher in 2007 had Italian TV been so captivated by an investigation.
sentences.zh: 自 2007 年梅雷迪思·基尔查谋杀案以来，意大利电视界还从未如此被一场调查迷住。

sentences.en: The Gambiracio family lowered their shutters and hid from the prying eyes of the national media.
sentences.zh: 甘比拉西奥一家关上了百叶窗，躲避全国媒体窥探的目光。

sentences.en: They refused the torchlight vigil the town hoped to have to raise awareness for Yara's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 他们拒绝了小镇希望举办的烛光守夜活动，以此来提高人们对亚拉失踪的关注，

sentences.en: and instead accepted the offer from nuns who taught at Yara's school to come and pray with the family.
sentences.zh: 而是接受了亚拉学校修女老师的提议，前来与家人一起祈祷。

sentences.en: A mass was held instead of the vigil, and the family pleaded with the public for privacy.
sentences.zh: 他们举行了弥撒而不是守夜活动，并且这家人恳求公众给予隐私。

sentences.en: Yara's father, Fulvio, was criticised for not being out there with the volunteers, constantly searching.
sentences.zh: 亚拉的父亲富尔维奥因没有和志愿者们一起出去不断搜寻而受到批评。

sentences.en: A similar thing can be said for many missing persons cases worldwide, but people deal with disappearances in many different ways,
sentences.zh: 世界各地的许多失踪人口案件都可以这么说，但人们面对失踪有各种各样的方式，

sentences.en: and Yara's father couldn't face the thought of being the one to come across his daughter's body.
sentences.zh: 而且亚拉的父亲无法面对自己亲眼撞见女儿尸体的想法。

sentences.en: He occupied his mind with video poker games and taking care of his other three children.
sentences.zh: 他通过玩视频扑克游戏和照顾其他三个孩子来分散注意力。

sentences.en: As part of their investigation, the police bugged the house of Fulvio and Mara to track their conversations.
sentences.zh: 作为调查的一部分，警方在富尔维奥和马拉的家中安装了窃听器以监控他们的对话。

sentences.en: While intercepting a phone call from one of the handsets known to have been in the area on the day, an interpreter working for the police overheard an alarming call.
sentences.zh: 在拦截其中一部已知案发当天在该地区的手机来电时，一名为警方工作的翻译无意中听到了一通令人震惊的电话。

sentences.en: While in mid-conversation, a Moroccan man, Mohamed Fikri, was overheard saying,
sentences.zh: 在交谈中，人们无意中听到一名摩洛哥男子穆罕默德·菲克里说，

sentences.en: Forgive me God, I didn't kill her.
sentences.zh: 上帝原谅我，我没有杀她。

sentences.en: At the time of Yara's disappearance, Fikri had been working in a builder's yard in Mapelo,
sentences.zh: 在亚拉失踪期间，菲克里一直在马佩洛的一家建筑工地工作，

sentences.en: but by the time the call was intercepted, three days later, Fikri was on board a boat bound for 10 years.
sentences.zh: 但当三天后这通电话被拦截时，菲克里已经登上一艘开往目的地的船只。

sentences.en: Three days later, in early December, Italian police intercepted the boat and Fikri was arrested.
sentences.zh: 三天后的 12 月初，意大利警方拦截了这艘船，菲克里被捕。

sentences.en: While searching the van he had been using, police found a blood-stained mattress.
sentences.zh: 在搜查他一直使用的货车时，警察发现了一个血迹斑斑的床垫。

sentences.en: The blood was tested, but what looked like to be a promising inquiry quickly fizzled out.
sentences.zh: 血迹经过了检测，但这个看起来很有希望的调查线索很快就无疾而终了。

sentences.en: The blood was found to have nothing to do with the case, and shortly after, news broke that the words overheard by the translator had been mistranslated.
sentences.zh: 经查明，该血迹与本案毫无关系，不久后有消息传出，翻译无意中听到的那些话翻译错了。

sentences.en: Fikri was cleared of any involvement.
sentences.zh: 菲克里被洗清了所有涉案嫌疑。

sentences.en: Ruggieri later stated,
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里后来表示，

sentences.en: People liked him as the guilty party, because he was foreign.
sentences.zh: 人们喜欢把他当成罪魁祸首，因为他是外国人。

sentences.en: No one wanted to believe that someone from their quiet and peaceful part of the country could be responsible for Yara's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 没有人愿意相信他们这个安静和平的地区会有人对亚拉的失踪负责。

sentences.en: Surveillance video footage was released showing a vehicle driving past the sports centre.
sentences.zh: 警方发布了一段监控录像，显示一辆汽车驶过体育中心。

sentences.en: It was a small white utility vehicle with an open back tray.
sentences.zh: 那是一辆带开放式后货箱的小型白色多用途车。

sentences.en: This vehicle was captured driving past the sports centre around the time of Yara's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 这辆车在亚拉失踪前后被拍到驶过体育中心。

sentences.en: The same vehicle was also shown to pass several times on other days leading up to her disappearance.
sentences.zh: 同一辆车还在她失踪前夕的其他日子里被拍到多次经过。

sentences.en: No registration plate was able to be seen on the footage, so police released images of the vehicle in the hope that either the owner would come forward
sentences.zh: 录像中看不到车牌，因此警方公布了该车的影像，希望车主能主动现身，

sentences.en: or someone else who recognised the vehicle would come forward.
sentences.zh: 或者其他认出这辆车的人能主动站出来。

sentences.en: A few days after Christmas, almost a month since their daughter had disappeared, the Gambirasio family, desperate, made a public, televised appeal.
sentences.zh: 圣诞节后几天，也就是女儿失踪将近一个月后，绝望的甘比拉西奥家族公开进行了电视求助。

sentences.en: They looked extremely awkward and uncomfortable in front of the media.
sentences.zh: 他们在媒体面前显得极其局促和不自在。

sentences.en: Mara was so uncomfortable, she was unintentionally rolling her eyes.
sentences.zh: 马拉浑身不自在，以至于不由自主地翻了个白眼。

sentences.en: Fulvio nervously read a plea.
sentences.zh: 富尔维奥紧张地宣读了一份求救信。

sentences.en: Open the door that separates her from her freedom.
sentences.zh: 打开那扇将她与自由隔绝的门吧。

sentences.en: Please give us our daughter back.
sentences.zh: 请把我们的女儿还给我们。

sentences.en: We are a simple family, a household whose unity is based on love, respect, sincerity and the glow of our peaceful existence.
sentences.zh: 我们是一个简单的家庭，一个以爱、尊重、真诚和我们平静生活的微光为团结基础的家庭。

sentences.en: For the past month, we have been asking ourselves endless questions about who, what, how, when and why all this is happening to us.
sentences.zh: 过去的一个月里，我们一直在不断地问自己关于是谁、什么、如何、何时以及为什么这一切会发生在我们身上的问题。

sentences.en: We are not looking for answers.
sentences.zh: 我们并不是在寻求答案。

sentences.en: We do not seek to know.
sentences.zh: 我们并不寻求去了解。

sentences.en: We are not tormenting ourselves trying to understand.
sentences.zh: 我们没有痛苦地试图去理解。

sentences.en: We are not pointing the finger at anyone.
sentences.zh: 我们没有把矛头指向任何人。

sentences.en: We just want, immensely, for our daughter to return to her world, to her village, to her home, to the embrace of those who love her.
sentences.zh: 我们只是无比渴望，我们的女儿能回到她的世界，回到她的村庄，回到她的家，回到那些爱她之人的怀抱。

sentences.en: We beg the compassion of the people who have taken Yara.
sentences.zh: 我们乞求带走亚拉的人发发慈悲。

sentences.en: We ask them to find some spark of love in their conscience, look her in the eyes, and open the door or gate that separates her from her freedom.
sentences.zh: 我们请他们在良知中寻找哪怕一丝爱意，看着她的眼睛，打开那扇将她与自由隔绝的门或大门。

sentences.en: We beseech you to give us our daughter back.
sentences.zh: 我们恳求你们把女儿还给我们。

sentences.en: Help us to piece our daily lives back together again.
sentences.zh: 帮我们把日常生活重新拼凑起来。

sentences.en: Help us to rebuild our normality.
sentences.zh: 帮我们重建正常的生活。

sentences.en: People know us.
sentences.zh: 人们了解我们。

sentences.en: We have never done or wished ill on anyone.
sentences.zh: 我们从未对任何人做过或祝愿过不好的事。

sentences.en: We have always shown we are an open, transparent family, ready to help others.
sentences.zh: 我们一直表现得我们是一个开放、透明的家庭，随时准备帮助他人。

sentences.en: We do not deserve to continue our life without Yara's smile.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该在没有亚拉微笑的情况下继续生活。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Rumours started to fly that this may have been a retaliation abduction.
sentences.zh: 有传言称这可能是一起报复性绑架。

sentences.en: The media started to report that Yara's father had testified against a mafia member in Naples, but it wasn't long before these rumours were confirmed to be completely false.
sentences.zh: 媒体开始报道称，亚拉的父亲曾在那不勒斯指证过一名黑手党成员，但不久这些传言就被证实完全是假的。

sentences.en: On the 25th of February, 2011, three months after Yara went missing, a middle-aged man named Ilario Scotti found an open field in the small town of Chignon d'Isola
sentences.zh: 2011 年 2 月 25 日，在亚拉失踪三个月后，一名叫伊拉里奥·斯科蒂的中年男子在奇尼翁多迪索拉小镇发现了一块空地，

sentences.en: to fly a remote-controlled aeroplane he had just bought.
sentences.zh: 用来试飞他刚买的遥控飞机。

sentences.en: The town is 10 kilometres south-west of Brembatte de Sopra and is surrounded by industrial estates, spare lots, fields and scrub.
sentences.zh: 该镇位于布伦巴泰迪索普拉西南 10 公里处，四周环绕着工业区、空置地块、田野和灌木丛。

sentences.en: As he flew the remote-controlled aircraft,
sentences.zh: 当他操控遥控飞机飞行时，

sentences.en: Ilario discovered it wasn't working properly, so he landed it amongst some tall grass.
sentences.zh: 伊拉里奥发现飞机运转不正常，于是把它降落在高高的草丛中。

sentences.en: As he walked over to pick it up, he saw what he thought were some rags and rubbish on the ground.
sentences.zh: 当他走过去捡起飞机时，他看到地上有一些他认为是破布和垃圾的东西。

sentences.en: That was until he saw the pair of shoes.
sentences.zh: 直到他看到了那双鞋子。

sentences.en: It was Yara's body.
sentences.zh: 那是亚拉的尸体。

sentences.en: Her body was frozen but showed some signs of decomposition, as did parts of her clothing.
sentences.zh: 她的尸体已经冻僵，但显示出一些腐烂的迹象，她的部分衣服也是如此。

sentences.en: This particular field had already been searched in the days after Yara's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 这块特定的田地在亚拉失踪后的几天里已经被搜查过了。

sentences.en: The police speculated that the killer had dumped her body after, knowing they had already searched there.
sentences.zh: 警方推测，凶手在得知他们已经搜查过这里后，才抛弃了她的尸体。

sentences.en: She appeared to have been attacked with a very sharp cutting object and there were several cuts on her body.
sentences.zh: 她似乎遭到了一件非常锋利的切割工具的袭击，身上有几处伤口。

sentences.en: Some were deep.
sentences.zh: 有些伤口很深。

sentences.en: Chief Inspector Ruggieri had spent that day skiing with her daughter and was on the drive home when she got the call that a body had been found.
sentences.zh: 总督察鲁杰里那天一直在和女儿滑雪，在驱车回家的路上接到了发现尸体的电话。

sentences.en: She dropped her daughter off at home and went straight to the crime scene.
sentences.zh: 她把女儿送回家中，随即便赶赴了犯罪现场。

sentences.en: In a way, Ruggieri felt relieved.
sentences.zh: 从某种程度上说，鲁杰里感到如释重负。

sentences.en: She told a journalist,
sentences.zh: 她对一名记者说道：

sentences.en: Yara's disappearance had really disturbed me.
sentences.zh: 亚拉的失踪对我的触动极深。

sentences.en: I'm a mother too.
sentences.zh: 我也是个母亲。

sentences.en: And the only thing worse than the death of a child is the disappearance of a child.
sentences.zh: 而世上唯一比失去孩子更痛苦的事，就是孩子失踪。

sentences.en: The scene was filled with state police officers,
sentences.zh: 现场挤满了国家警察局的警员、

sentences.en: Carabinieri military police members, and crime scene investigators.
sentences.zh: 宪兵部队成员以及犯罪现场调查人员。

sentences.en: Near the body, they found Yara's iPod and house keys.
sentences.zh: 他们在尸体附近找到了亚拉的iPod和家门钥匙。

sentences.en: They found the SIM card and battery for her LG phone, but the phone itself was missing.
sentences.zh: 他们找到了她LG手机的SIM卡和电池，但手机本身却不见了。

sentences.en: Forensic evidence was found at the scene and swabs were taken.
sentences.zh: 现场提取到了法医物证，并采集了棉签样本。

sentences.en: There had been many days of snow in the three months since Yara went missing, and the freezing temperatures had helped to preserve
sentences.zh: 自亚拉失踪后的三个月里，当地下了好几天的雪，严寒的天气有助于保存

sentences.en: some of the forensic evidence that may have ordinarily been destroyed.
sentences.zh: 一些本可能被破坏的法医物证。

sentences.en: The autopsy was conducted by Italy's most famous forensic pathologist,
sentences.zh: 尸检由意大利最著名的法医病理学家、

sentences.en: Professor Cristina Cataneo.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂娜·卡塔内奥教授进行。

sentences.en: She discovered traces of lime in Yara's respiratory tract, and the presence of a vegetable fibre used to make rope on Yara's clothing.
sentences.zh: 她在亚拉的气管中发现了石灰痕迹，并在亚拉的衣物上发现了常用于制作绳索的植物纤维。

sentences.en: She suffered a head injury, possibly inflicted with a rock, and several blows to the body.
sentences.zh: 她的头部受了伤，可能是被石头击打所致，身体也受到了多处重击。

sentences.en: She had also been stabbed numerous times, but it was determined that she didn't die from the lacerations or from loss of blood.
sentences.zh: 她还身中数刀，但经确定，她并非死于刀伤或失血过多。

sentences.en: It appeared Yara had died from exposure to the cold weather after she lost consciousness.
sentences.zh: 迹象表明，亚拉是在失去意识后因暴露在寒冷天气中而冻死的。

sentences.en: It was noted in the report that the presence of lime and the rope fibres suggested that the killer might be in the building trade.
sentences.zh: 报告中指出，石灰和绳索纤维的存在表明凶手可能从事建筑行业。

sentences.en: Two months later, in April, the commander of the Scientific Investigations Department in Palma phoned Ruggieri.
sentences.zh: 两个月后的4月，帕尔马科学调查局局长给鲁杰里打来电话。

sentences.en: He reported it was likely that the murderer had himself been wounded in the struggle, leaving his DNA on Yara's underwear.
sentences.zh: 他汇报称，凶手在搏斗中很可能也受了伤，从而在亚拉的内衣上留下了自己的DNA。

sentences.en: This led them to the theory that it was likely the attacker had attempted to assault Yara, but she had given a good fight and stopped him,
sentences.zh: 这让他们推断出这样一种理论：袭击者当时很可能试图侵犯亚拉，但亚拉进行了强烈的反抗并阻止了他，

sentences.en: or maybe his intentions were interrupted in some other way.
sentences.zh: 或者他的企图以其他某种方式被打断了。

sentences.en: There was no sign of sexual assault.
sentences.zh: 没有性侵的迹象。

sentences.en: It was confirmed that Yara had likely been dumped unconscious and died of exposure.
sentences.zh: 经证实，亚拉很可能是在失去知觉的状态下被抛尸并因暴露在恶劣天气中致死。

sentences.en: On the 28th of May, three months after the discovery,
sentences.zh: 5月28日，即尸体被发现三个月后，

sentences.en: Yara's body was handed back to the Gambiracio family for her funeral.
sentences.zh: 亚拉的遗体被交还给甘比拉西奥一家以筹备葬礼。

sentences.en: On that hot morning, thousands lined the streets leading up to the sports centre she had disappeared from.
sentences.zh: 那个炎热的早晨，成千上万的人排在街道两侧，一直延伸到她失踪的那个体育中心。

sentences.en: As the hearse slowly drove by and onlookers saw the white coffin topped with a huge bouquet of white flowers, their wailing cries turned into loud cheers,
sentences.zh: 当灵车缓缓驶过，旁观者们看到那辆上面摆着一大束白花的白色棺材时，他们的哭声化作了高呼，

sentences.en: as the community gave Yara an emotional send-off.
sentences.zh: 整个社区以极其感人的方式为亚拉送行。

sentences.en: The funeral was held by the Bishop of Bergamo.
sentences.zh: 葬礼由贝加莫主教主持。

sentences.en: A message was read out from the President of the Italian Republic, and outside, those who couldn't fit in the gymnasium,
sentences.zh: 现场宣读了意大利共和国总统发来的唁电，而在体育馆外，那些挤不进去的人们

sentences.en: lined the car park and street to watch the memorial on a giant screen.
sentences.zh: 排满了停车场和街道，通过巨型屏幕观看追悼会。

sentences.en: Yara was buried between her two grandparents in a cemetery just across the road from the sports centre.
sentences.zh: 亚拉被安葬在体育中心马路对面墓地里的两个祖父母之间。

sentences.en: There's no date on her headstone, just a signature next to a photograph of her.
sentences.zh: 她的墓碑上没有日期，只有她的照片旁的一个签名。

sentences.en: Friends have left mementos like gym shoes, metal flowers, rag dolls, plastic angels, and little bracelets.
sentences.zh: 朋友们留下了运动鞋、金属花、布娃娃、塑料天使和小手链等纪念物。

sentences.en: After the funeral, police gave a statement that was not just intended to put Yara's family and the public at ease that they would find the killer,
sentences.zh: 葬礼结束后，警方发表了一份声明，其目的不仅是为了让亚拉的家人和公众放心，向他们保证警方一定会找到凶手，

sentences.en: but it was also intended to scare the person responsible.
sentences.zh: 同时也是为了恐吓真凶。

sentences.en: Scare them so that they knew the investigators had good forensic evidence.
sentences.zh: 吓唬他们，让他们知道调查人员已经掌握了确凿的法医证据。

sentences.en: They said,
sentences.zh: 他们说：

sentences.en: Despite exposure to the wind, rain, and snow, those two DNA traces were excellent, and we were able to exclude saliva and sperm.
sentences.zh: 尽管经历了风吹雨打和雪覆，那两处DNA痕迹依然极佳，并且我们已经排除了唾液和精液。

sentences.en: So that leaves blood.
sentences.zh: 那么剩下的就是血液了。

sentences.en: It was a message to the killer that they had a solid piece of DNA, and they would spare no expense in both time and costs to hunt him down.
sentences.zh: 这是向凶手发出一个信号：他们掌握了一份坚实的DNA证据，并且将在不计时间和成本的情况下全力将他缉拿归案。

sentences.en: The killer was given a nickname,
sentences.zh: 凶手被起了一个外号，

sentences.en: Unknown One, and the investigation to find Unknown One kicked into overdrive.
sentences.zh: “未知者”，搜寻“未知者”的调查工作进入了白热化阶段。

sentences.en: Casefile will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 《案卷》节目稍后回归。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的赞助商广告以支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Casefile to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您也是在支持《案卷》继续为您提供优质内容。

sentences.en: The search for Unknown One included, alongside Ruggieri, a select team of eight special agents, who despite huge media pressure,
sentences.zh: 搜寻“未知者”的行动除了鲁杰里之外，还包括一个由八名特工组成的精选团队，他们不顾巨大的媒体压力，

sentences.en: maintained utter silence throughout the investigation.
sentences.zh: 在整个调查过程中保持了绝对的沉默。

sentences.en: The media were like vultures over this case, and they weren't prepared to risk any leads getting out.
sentences.zh: 媒体在这个案件上就像盘旋的秃鹫一样，警方绝不准备冒任何线索泄露的风险。

sentences.en: The largest DNA dragnet in Italy's history was about to unfold.
sentences.zh: 意大利历史上最大规模的DNA大搜捕即将展开。

sentences.en: They continued to tap the phones of thousands of people and called for the public's help to volunteer DNA samples to catch Yara's killer.
sentences.zh: 他们继续对数千人的电话进行窃听，并呼吁公众自愿提供DNA样本来协助抓捕亚拉的凶手。

sentences.en: Classmates, families of classmates, friends, and members of the community came forward.
sentences.zh: 同班同学、同学家属、朋友以及社区成员纷纷前来配合。

sentences.en: Ruggieri felt lucky she didn't have to get any court orders to obtain DNA from any person, as everyone they contacted was willing.
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里感到很庆幸，她不需要为了获取任何人的DNA而申请法院搜查令，因为他们联系的每一个人都非常配合。

sentences.en: It is believed that up to 22,000 people from the area volunteered their DNA.
sentences.zh: 据信该地区有多达22,000人自愿提供了DNA。

sentences.en: This raised a few eyebrows across Italy, with people believing the investigators were haphazard and had no focus in their investigation.
sentences.zh: 这在整个意大利引起了不小的侧目，人们认为调查人员毫无章法，调查工作缺乏重点。

sentences.en: Ruggieri was publicly called incompetent, and some even asked for her to be replaced as the head of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里公开被人斥为无能，甚至有人要求撤换她这个调查负责人。

sentences.en: She wasn't your expected lead investigator, but she was tough, and she was like a dog at a bone.
sentences.zh: 她并非那种常规意义上的主力调查员，但她性格顽强，就像咬住骨头的狗一样死不松口。

sentences.en: Amongst all the backlash, she kept it cool.
sentences.zh: 在所有的猛烈抨击中，她始终保持冷静。

sentences.en: She reassured the community she knew what she was doing.
sentences.zh: 她向社区保证自己知道在做什么。

sentences.en: She divided up the responsibilities amongst the team.
sentences.zh: 她将各项职责分派给了团队成员。

sentences.en: The first person to give DNA samples were family members.
sentences.zh: 第一批提供DNA样本的是家属成员。

sentences.en: Then, each owner of the phone numbers who had made or received calls or messages to Yara were tracked down, and DNA was requested from them.
sentences.zh: 接着，所有曾与亚拉拨打过、接听过电话或收发过信息的电话号码的主人都被追踪到，并被要求提供DNA。

sentences.en: The net then moved outward into the community.
sentences.zh: 随后，搜索网向外扩散至整个社区。

sentences.en: The DNA matching was slow work.
sentences.zh: DNA比对是一项缓慢的工作。

sentences.en: It took different geneticists in Parma, Pavia, and Rome a minimum of six hours to transform just a few samples of DNA into something which could be read and compared.
sentences.zh: 帕尔马、帕维亚和罗马的几位遗传学家花费了至少六个小时，才将短短几份DNA样本转化为可供阅读和比对的数据。

sentences.en: The cost in materials and manpower made this investigation one of the most expensive manhunts in Italian history.
sentences.zh: 材料和人力的成本使这项调查成为意大利历史上最昂贵的搜捕行动之一。

sentences.en: As the investigation continued, police placed hidden cameras at Yara's gravesite in case her killer visited.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的继续，警方在亚拉的墓地安装了隐蔽摄像头，以防凶手前来凭吊。

sentences.en: They then turned their sights to a nightclub in the estate nearby to where Yara's body was found, called La Sabi Mobili, or Quicksim.
sentences.zh: 随后，他们的视线转向了亚拉尸体被发现附近庄园的一家名为La Sabi Mobili（意为“快信”）的夜总会。

sentences.en: Luckily for the investigation, managers of the nightclub had a policy of creating membership cards for anyone who entered, complete with phone numbers.
sentences.zh: 对调查幸运的是，该夜总会管理人员有一项政策，即为每位入内者办理会员卡，并完整记录电话号码。

sentences.en: Investigators worked through all of the people who had visited the nightclub around the time of Yara's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 调查人员排查了所有在亚拉失踪前后光顾过该夜总会的人。

sentences.en: They requested DNA samples, and were in luck.
sentences.zh: 他们索取了DNA样本，并且运气不错。

sentences.en: They found one of the people who volunteered had DNA closely resembling the prime suspect,
sentences.zh: 他们发现其中一位自愿提供样本的人，其DNA与主要嫌疑人——

sentences.en: Unknown One.
sentences.zh: “未知者”高度相似。

sentences.en: The owner of the sample that resembled Unknown One was a 20-year-old man named Damiano Guarioni.
sentences.zh: 这个与“未知者”相似的样本所有者是一名20岁的小伙子，名叫达米亚诺·瓜里奥尼（Damiano Guarioni）。

sentences.en: He was quickly excluded as the suspect, as he had been in South America when Yara disappeared, and his DNA wasn't an exact match.
sentences.zh: 他很快被排除作案嫌疑，因为亚拉失踪时他在南美洲，而且他的DNA并非完全匹配。

sentences.en: But what was clear was that he was a close-blood relative of Unknown One.
sentences.zh: 但显而易见的是，他是“未知者”的近亲血亲。

sentences.en: Ruggieri and her team were ecstatic.
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里和她的团队欣喜若狂。

sentences.en: They felt it would only be a matter of days before they would have the murderer behind bars.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得要不了几天就能把凶手捉拿归案了。

sentences.en: It didn't take long for the team to track down Damiano's family.
sentences.zh: 团队很快便追踪到了达米亚诺的家人。

sentences.en: Ruggieri was shocked to find that Damiano's mother,
sentences.zh: 让鲁杰里震惊的是，达米亚诺的母亲——

sentences.en: Aurora, had actually worked for Yara's family for 10 years as a housemaid.
sentences.zh: 奥罗拉（Aurora），居然在亚拉家当了10年保姆。

sentences.en: Aurora lived nearby, and had been at Yara's house twice a week since she was a baby.
sentences.zh: 奥罗拉就住在附近，自亚拉婴儿时期起，她每周就会去亚拉家两次。

sentences.en: Aurora and Yara were very close too.
sentences.zh: 奥罗拉和亚拉的关系也非常亲密。

sentences.en: Yara always asked Aurora if she would watch her do her gymnastics routines, and Aurora, who was very protective of Yara, was forever telling her to be careful.
sentences.zh: 亚拉总是让奥罗拉看她练习体操动作，而对亚拉保护欲极强的奥罗拉则总是不停地叮嘱她要注意安全。

sentences.en: When investigators questioned Aurora, she said that it was the worst thing that had ever happened to her.
sentences.zh: 当调查人员盘问奥罗拉时，她说这是她经历过的最糟糕的事情。

sentences.en: She was distraught.
sentences.zh: 她心烦意乱，痛苦不堪。

sentences.en: Police didn't tell her that her son, Damiano, had been identified as being a close-blood relative of the killer.
sentences.zh: 警方并没有告诉她，她的儿子达米亚诺已被确认是凶手的近亲血亲。

sentences.en: Police had Aurora and Damiano followed.
sentences.zh: 警方对奥罗拉和达米亚诺进行了跟踪。

sentences.en: They bugged their house and tapped their phones.
sentences.zh: 他们在他们家里安装了窃听器，并对他们的电话进行了监听。

sentences.en: But after months of surveillance in the summer of 2011, the investigators realised they weren't connected to the murder.
sentences.zh: 但在2011年夏天经过数月的监控后，调查人员意识到他们与这起谋杀案无关。

sentences.en: This didn't alter the fact that Damiano's DNA was so similar to unknown one.
sentences.zh: 这并没有改变达米亚诺的DNA与“未知者”高度相似这一事实。

sentences.en: Damiano's father, Joseph, was one of 11.
sentences.zh: 达米亚诺的父亲约瑟夫（Joseph）在11个兄弟姐妹中排行老大（注：one of 11意为11个孩子之一）。

sentences.en: One by one, the investigators spoke to each of Damiano's uncles and aunts and retrieved DNA samples.
sentences.zh: 调查人员逐一找到了达米亚诺的每一位叔伯和姑姨，并提取了DNA样本。

sentences.en: One of Damiano's uncles, his father's brother Giuseppe, had died in 1999.
sentences.zh: 达米亚诺的一位叔叔、他父亲的兄弟朱塞佩（Giuseppe）已于1999年去世。

sentences.en: After clearing through the rest of the family, police still needed to rule out the family of Giuseppe.
sentences.zh: 在排除了家族其余人员之后，警方仍需排除朱塞佩的家系。

sentences.en: They contacted the widow of Giuseppe, Laura.
sentences.zh: 他们联系了朱塞佩的遗孀劳拉（Laura）。

sentences.en: She showed them a box of documents that had belonged to her husband in the hopes that they could find something to gain his DNA from.
sentences.zh: 她向他们展示了一箱她丈夫生前留下的物品，希望能从中找到可以提取他DNA的东西。

sentences.en: Considering he had died many years before Yara's murder,
sentences.zh: 考虑到他在亚拉遇害多年前就已经去世，

sentences.en: Laura didn't feel too worried.
sentences.zh: 劳拉并没有感到太担心。

sentences.en: In the box, they found an envelope with a stamp on it.
sentences.zh: 在箱子里，他们发现了一个贴有邮票的信封。

sentences.en: They also found a postcard he had sent to his family.
sentences.zh: 他们还找到了一张他寄给家人的明信片。

sentences.en: They knew there was a high chance he had licked the stamps, meaning they would have his DNA.
sentences.zh: 他们知道他舔过邮票的几率很高，这意味着上面会有他的DNA。

sentences.en: They were able to confirm it was Giuseppe who had licked the stamps.
sentences.zh: 他们得以确证是朱塞佩舔了这些邮票。

sentences.en: And the DNA sequence was an even closer match to unknown one than his nephew Damiano's.
sentences.zh: 并且，该DNA序列与“未知者”的匹配度甚至比他侄子达米亚诺的还要高。

sentences.en: This meant Giuseppe was the father of the killer.
sentences.zh: 这意味着朱塞佩就是凶手的父亲。

sentences.en: The team started to build the picture of Giuseppe and his family.
sentences.zh: 团队开始勾勒出朱塞佩及其家庭的面貌。

sentences.en: Laura and Giuseppe seemed to have had a conventional marriage.
sentences.zh: 劳拉和朱塞佩似乎拥有过一段传统的婚姻。

sentences.en: Giuseppe had been a local bus driver who also enjoyed playing the accordion at local festivals.
sentences.zh: 朱塞佩曾是一名当地的公交车司机，他也喜欢在当地节日上拉手风琴。

sentences.en: Together they had three children, a daughter and two sons.
sentences.zh: 他们育有三个孩子，一个女儿和两个儿子。

sentences.en: The investigators focused on the two sons as they knew the killer was male.
sentences.zh: 由于已知凶手为男性，调查人员将重点放在了这两个儿子身上。

sentences.en: But DNA checks showed that neither man was unknown one.
sentences.zh: 但DNA检测表明，这两个人均非“未知者”。

sentences.en: And neither of them had children of their own.
sentences.zh: 并且他们俩也都没有自己的孩子。

sentences.en: The forensics team was convinced that Giuseppe was the father of unknown one.
sentences.zh: 法医团队确信朱塞佩是“未知者”的父亲。

sentences.en: So that left only one possibility.
sentences.zh: 因此只剩下了一种可能。

sentences.en: Somewhere out there was the illegitimate son of Giuseppe.
sentences.zh: 在某个地方，存在着朱塞佩的私生子。

sentences.en: In order to make absolutely sure, investigators had Giuseppe's body exhumed from its vault in the local cemetery.
sentences.zh: 为了绝对确凿，调查人员将朱塞佩的遗体从当地墓地的墓穴中掘出。

sentences.en: And another DNA test was performed.
sentences.zh: 并进行了又一次DNA检测。

sentences.en: It was confirmed again.
sentences.zh: 再次得到了证实。

sentences.en: Giuseppe was the father of unknown one.
sentences.zh: 朱塞佩就是“未知者”的父亲。

sentences.en: Police were now making a complete U-turn in their investigation.
sentences.zh: 警方现在的调查方向来了个一百八十度的大转弯。

sentences.en: Instead of searching for a man, they were searching for a woman.
sentences.zh: 他们不再寻找一名男性，而是在寻找一名女性。

sentences.en: The killer's mother.
sentences.zh: 凶手的母亲。

sentences.en: A woman, possibly in her 60s, who had had an affair with Giuseppe decades earlier.
sentences.zh: 一个可能在60岁左右、几十年前曾与朱塞佩有染的女人。

sentences.en: Got pregnant, and went on to have Giuseppe's son.
sentences.zh: 她怀了孕，并生下了朱塞佩的儿子。

sentences.en: Who then went on to kill Yarra.
sentences.zh: 而这个儿子后来杀害了亚拉。

sentences.en: The team got to work investigating the bus routes Giuseppe used to drive.
sentences.zh: 团队开始着手调查朱塞佩过去驾驶过的公交线路。

sentences.en: A fellow bus driver remembered him and told the police,
sentences.zh: 一位同行的公交车司机还记得他，并对警方说：

sentences.en: Ah yes, he was a ladies' man.
sentences.zh: 啊对，他挺招女人喜欢的。

sentences.en: Lots of young women travelled on his bus to work.
sentences.zh: 有很多年轻女性坐他的车去上班。

sentences.en: One at leaSt.
sentences.zh: 至少有一个。

sentences.en: He got into trouble.
sentences.zh: 他惹上麻烦了。

sentences.en: Another bus driver said, He was a man with a capital M.
sentences.zh: 另一位公交车司机说：“他是个顶天立地的男子汉。”

sentences.en: News ended up getting out that police were searching for the mother of unknown one, who had had an affair.
sentences.zh: 消息最终走漏了，称警方正在寻找“未知者”曾有过婚外情的母亲。

sentences.en: And the media lost it.
sentences.zh: 媒体彻底疯狂了。

sentences.en: It turned into a soap opera.
sentences.zh: 这演变成了一部肥皂剧。

sentences.en: In all the media excitement, police reminded the public that amongst all the speculation, finger-pointing, and gossip, a young girl had been murdered.
sentences.zh: 在媒体的一片狂热中，警方提醒公众：在种种揣测、指责和八卦的背后，是一个年轻女孩惨遭杀害。

sentences.en: In the summer of 2013, in the nearby city of Rowe, staff at the hospital chapel came across a confession in their visitor's book.
sentences.zh: 2013年夏天，在附近的罗韦市，当地医院小教堂的工作人员在访客留言簿上偶然发现了一份忏悔信。

sentences.en: Usually reserved for the thoughts and prayers of sick loved ones, or thanks for the help of doctors, they were shocked to find handwritten inside.
sentences.zh: 这里通常是留给生病亲友的寄语和祈祷，或是对医生帮助的感谢，然而他们震惊地发现上面手写着：

sentences.en: Tell the police of Bergamo that the killer of Yarra Gambirasio was here.
sentences.zh: 告诉贝加莫警方，亚拉·甘比拉西奥的凶手就在这里。

sentences.en: May God forgive me.
sentences.zh: 愿上帝宽恕我。

sentences.en: Police stated,
sentences.zh: 警方表示：

sentences.en: Whether the letter was written by a compulsive liar or not, it is important that we do not stop investigating.
sentences.zh: 无论这封信是否由一个强迫性说谎者所写，重要的是我们绝不能停止调查。

sentences.en: We have a duty to give answers to a family that has waited, in silence, to know the truth.
sentences.zh: 我们有责任给一个在沉默中等待真相的家庭一个交代。

sentences.en: By mid-2013, the life of a young Giuseppe began to unfold.
sentences.zh: 到2013年中期，年轻时朱塞佩的生活轨迹开始浮出水面。

sentences.en: He had moved villages in the mid-1960s, and he drove a public bus for almost two decades, where he would drive numerous women to their jobs in the local textile factories.
sentences.zh: 他在20世纪60年代中期搬过村子，开了近二十年的公共汽车，期间他曾搭载过无数女性前往当地纺织厂上班。

sentences.en: They searched orphanages and homes for single mothers, testing everyone they could find, but turned up nothing.
sentences.zh: 他们搜查了孤儿院和单亲母亲收容所，对所有能找到的人进行了检测，但一无所获。

sentences.en: They realised that there was a high chance that the woman they were searching for was married to someone else, and had the child in secret.
sentences.zh: 他们意识到，他们寻找的那名女性很有可能嫁给了别人，并且秘密生下了这个孩子。

sentences.en: There were 532 women listed as possibly being the woman who was the mother of unknown one.
sentences.zh: 有 532 名女性被列为可能是“未知一号”母亲的人选。

sentences.en: The team began the task of tracking down each one.
sentences.zh: 专案组开始着手追踪其中的每一个人。

sentences.en: As police conducted their hunt for the mother of unknown one, the villages surrounding Bergamo were searched, conversations and whispers leading police from one house to the next.
sentences.zh: 随着警方对“未知一号”母亲的搜寻展开，贝加尔莫周边的村庄都被搜了个遍，谈话与私语引领着警方从一户人家搜到另一户人家。

sentences.en: One by one, talking to each woman on their list of over 500.
sentences.zh: 他们逐一排查，与那份多达 500 多人的名单上的每一位女性进行交谈。

sentences.en: In the small villages, older people still lived like long ago, some with home phones, some without.
sentences.zh: 在这些小村庄里，老人们仍然过着过去那种生活，有些人家里有座机，有些人则没有。

sentences.en: Most were reserved, but some openly questioned the tactics police were using.
sentences.zh: 大多数人比较保守，但也有人公开质疑警方采用的战术。

sentences.en: By now it was June 2014, three and a half years after Yarra had disappeared.
sentences.zh: 此时已是 2014 年 6 月，距离亚拉失踪已经过去了三年半。

sentences.en: The killer only had to drive three hours, and he could be in France,
sentences.zh: 凶手只需开车三小时就能进入法国，

sentences.en: Switzerland,
sentences.zh: 瑞士，

sentences.en: Austria or Slovenia.
sentences.zh: 奥地利或斯洛文尼亚。

sentences.en: The chance of the killer still being in the hilltop villages of Lombardi seemed unlikely.
sentences.zh: 凶手仍然藏身于伦巴第山顶村庄的可能性微乎其微。

sentences.en: But police were persistent, and one day, they finally got a name.
sentences.zh: 但警方坚持不懈，终于在某一天得到了一个名字。

sentences.en: It was apparently given reluctantly, in a whisper.
sentences.zh: 显然，这个名字是在耳语中很不情愿地透露出来的。

sentences.en: Esther Azulfi
sentences.zh: 埃丝特·阿祖尔菲

sentences.en: In the late 1960s,
sentences.zh: 20 世纪 60 年代末，

sentences.en: Esther had been Giuseppe's neighbour.
sentences.zh: 埃丝特曾是朱зе普的邻居。

sentences.en: She married a man named Giovanni Bassetti from a nearby village.
sentences.zh: 她嫁给了一个名叫乔瓦尼·巴塞蒂的邻村男子。

sentences.en: Giovanni was the total opposite to Esther.
sentences.zh: 乔瓦尼和埃丝特截然相反。

sentences.en: Esther was fun and outgoing.
sentences.zh: 埃丝特性格开朗、爱交际。

sentences.en: Giovanni was an inward man who kept entirely to himself.
sentences.zh: 乔瓦尼则内向孤僻，完全离群索居。

sentences.en: He suffered from arthritis and depression.
sentences.zh: 他患有关节炎和抑郁症。

sentences.en: Esther had a job in a textile factory, and rode the bus to work every day.
sentences.zh: 埃丝特在一家纺织厂工作，每天坐公交车上下班。

sentences.en: Esther and Giovanni had brought up three children.
sentences.zh: 埃丝特和乔瓦尼抚养了三个孩子。

sentences.en: Twins, a man and a woman now in their early 40s, and another son.
sentences.zh: 一对龙凤胎——现在四十岁出头的一男一女，还有一个儿子。

sentences.en: Grugieri's team checked their records, and found that two years earlier, in 2012,
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里的团队核查了他们的记录，发现早在两年前的 2012 年，

sentences.en: Esther had actually given her DNA for testing voluntarily, during the sweep of the area police had already done.
sentences.zh: 在警方先前对该地区进行的普查中，埃丝特其实就已经自愿提供过 DNA 样本用于检测。

sentences.en: But an error had been made by a geneticist in Rome.
sentences.zh: 但罗马的一名遗传学家犯了一个错误。

sentences.en: The lab technician had tried to match Esther's, and presumably others,
sentences.zh: 实验室技术人员试图将埃丝特的 DNA（推测也包括其他人的）

sentences.en: DNA to Yara's, instead of to Unknown One.
sentences.zh: 与亚拉的进行比对，而不是与“未知一号”的进行比对。

sentences.en: Therefore, the result came up, no match.
sentences.zh: 因此，检测结果显示为：无匹配。

sentences.en: They rushed to retest Esther's sample, and confirmed that Esther, now in her 60s, was the woman they had been searching for.
sentences.zh: 他们赶忙重新检测了埃丝特的样本，并确认如今已 60 多岁的埃丝特正是他们一直在寻找的那名女性。

sentences.en: She was the mother of Unknown One.
sentences.zh: 她就是“未知一号”的母亲。

sentences.en: She and Giovanni lived in Brambate di Sopra.
sentences.zh: 她和乔瓦尼住在布伦巴特迪索普拉。

sentences.en: The investigation had done a full circle back, to the small village Yara had lived in, and disappeared from.
sentences.zh: 调查兜了一个大圈，又回到了亚拉曾经居住并失踪的小村庄。

sentences.en: Esther denied ever having an affair with Giuseppe, but the police knew her sons were born, in the right time period.
sentences.zh: 埃丝特否认曾与朱зе普有染，但警方深知她的儿子们确实出生在那个时间段内。

sentences.en: One son was quickly ruled out.
sentences.zh: 其中一个儿子很快被排除嫌疑。

sentences.en: The other, who was the male of the twins,
sentences.zh: 另一个儿子，也就是那对双胞胎中的男性，

sentences.en: Massimo Bossetti, was a 42-year-old married father of three.
sentences.zh: 马西莫·博塞蒂，是一名 42 岁的已婚父亲，育有三个孩子。

sentences.en: He lived in Mapello, where the last signal from Yara's phone pinged.
sentences.zh: 他住在马佩洛，亚拉手机发出的最后一个信号正是在那里被探测到的。

sentences.en: He was a bricklayer, and had not given a DNA sample, during the investigation.
sentences.zh: 他是一名泥瓦匠，在调查期间并未提供 DNA 样本。

sentences.en: A slim man, who was once known for his love to party,
sentences.zh: 他身材苗条，曾因热爱派对而闻名，

sentences.en: Massimo was nicknamed the animal, by his friends.
sentences.zh: 马西莫被朋友们昵称为“动物”。

sentences.en: He was short, and very tanned, with piercing blue eyes, and a peroxided pencil goatee.
sentences.zh: 他个子不高，皮肤黝黑，有着一双锐利的蓝眼睛，还留着一抹漂染过的铅笔细山羊胡。

sentences.en: Ruggieri and her team moved quickly, but they had to be careful.
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里和她的团队迅速采取行动，但他们必须小心谨慎。

sentences.en: They had already made one incorrect arrest, and would not be making another.
sentences.zh: 他们已经有过一次错误逮捕，绝不能再犯第二次。

sentences.en: They decided not to ask Massimo, for his DNA sample, in case he disappeared, while they were waiting for the results.
sentences.zh: 他们决定不向马西莫索要 DNA 样本，以免他在他们等待结果期间逃跑。

sentences.en: They placed him under surveillance, and observed his movements.
sentences.zh: 他们对他实施了监控，观察他的一举一动。

sentences.en: Within a few days, they decided the best approach, would be to set up a roadblock, near his house, for random breath testing.
sentences.zh: 几天之内，他们认为最好的方法是在他家附近设置一个路障，进行随机呼气酒精测试。

sentences.en: This way they could collect his DNA, without him suspecting anything.
sentences.zh: 这样他们就可以在马西莫毫无察觉的情况下收集他的 DNA。

sentences.en: Massimo was driving home, with his wife and three children, when he was stopped by police.
sentences.zh: 马西莫正开车带着妻子和三个孩子回家，这时被警察拦了下来。

sentences.en: The officer knew exactly what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 警官非常清楚自己在做什么。

sentences.en: He pretended the first breath test didn't work, and so performed the second one.
sentences.zh: 他假装第一次呼气测试没成功，于是进行了第二次。

sentences.en: The officers now had two sets of Massimo's DNA, and Massimo had no idea the random breath test, was actually a test, to confirm if he had murdered Yarra.
sentences.zh: 现在警官们手里有了两份马西莫的 DNA，而马西莫根本不知道这个随机呼气测试实际上是为了确认他是否谋杀了亚拉的测试。

sentences.en: The following day, on the 16th of June 2014,
sentences.zh: 第二天，即 2014 年 6 月 16 日，

sentences.en: Ruggieri received a call, she had been waiting for.
sentences.zh: 鲁杰里接到了她一直在等待的电话。

sentences.en: Massimo Borsetti, was unknown one.
sentences.zh: 马西莫·博塞蒂就是“未知一号”。

sentences.en: The results showed 21 compatible markers,
sentences.zh: 结果显示有 21 个相容标记，

sentences.en: 16 to 17 are normally considered enough, meaning the forensic experts, were completely sure, that Massimo was the murderer.
sentences.zh: 通常认为 16 到 17 个就足够了，这意味着法医专家完全确信马西莫就是凶手。

sentences.en: Esther's husband,
sentences.zh: 埃丝特的丈夫

sentences.en: Giovanni, would learn that his wife, had actually had more than one affair.
sentences.zh: 乔瓦尼将得知，他的妻子其实不止有过一段婚外情。
